description: [Live · API now available] Next-generation native multimodal AI video creation model: native 30s generation, smoother high-dynamic motions, omni reference (up to 15 references), up to 10 keyframes, and precise localized editing of finished videos. Capability map parameters: input text/image/video, duration 3~30s, resolution 720P/1080P/4K, dynamic range SDR/10-bit HDR, aspect ratios 21:9/16:9/1:1/9:16/adaptive. Billing (official Units; 4K not priced): no input video (total = output duration) 1.0 Unit/s at 720P, 1.5 Units/s at 1080P; with input video and input <= output (total = output x 2) 0.6 Units/s at 720P, 0.9 Units/s at 1080P; with input video and input > output (total = input + output) 0.6/0.9 Units/s. Official notice: to call the Kling 4.0 model, purchase the Flagship Resource Pack or contact the account manager to top up the account balance.
